g.text: Agent cloud startup Daytona hits $1B valuation backed by FirstMark and a who’s who of angels ◆ Commonwealth Fusion Systems gets $85M to build better fusion-ready semiconductors ◆ What some of Anthropic’s backers are reportedly worth before its IPO ◆ Lab testing giant Quest Diagnostics confirms patients’ personal and health data was compromised during breach ◆ Oura sues rival Ultrahuman again, threatening its US smart ring comeback ◆ Uber rival inDrive eyes 2027 robotaxi tests in Central Asia with Pony AI and Nvidia ◆
